Bart soon discovers that Tim carries hardships—and secrets—of his own, forcing him to face his past and repair his relationships with Sam and his wife Shannon before fame costs him what matters most.

1635401.title: Materia Prima
1635401.overview: Bolivia has the world's largest deposits of lithium, a metal that is essential for the energy transition. Without lithium, no electricity storage facility, no data centre, no electric car, no smartphone would work. The Europeans want the raw material to save their automotive industry. The Bolivians want it to combat poverty. While the Bolivian government negotiates with corporations from around the world, civil society groups are mobilising in rural areas, organised mainly by women. The film offers a rare insight into the Europeans' strategy to secure the sought-after material and carves out the conflicting interests towards extractivism and industrialisation in Bolivia.

1636745.title: A Film to Remind Us of Utopia
1636745.overview: In Esdras Baptista's film archives, kept at his home for decades, one can feel the fervor of those who believed in a new tomorrow. Filmed in Brazil in the early 1960s, in the heat of a libertarian political movement, the filmmaker's images materialize the incandescence of collective desires at the historic moment of their emergence. Utopia, though unattainable, is never a mere abstraction. A force that mobilizes actions and feelings, it constitutes the impetus necessary for human existence.

1637001.title: Nocturne in White
1637001.overview: An office worker drifts through a nameless government building that runs experiments on humans. As repetition begins to distort her reality, she becomes overwhelmed by the guilt and the sneaking suspicion that she may also be a subject of experimentation.

1637577.title: Gak Ada Matinya!
1637577.overview: Amidst imminent financial ruin, a debt-ridden man experiences profound relief upon discovering his estranged late father’s substantial life insurance policy—only to be thrown into an absurd moral crisis when the patriarch unexpectedly resuscitates inside the hearse en route to the funeral home.

1640649.title: Love Lottery

But as the courtroom battle begins, every testimony uncovers new questions instead of answers. Hidden relationships, conflicting statements, and buried secrets gradually transform a simple murder trial into a gripping mystery where nothing is as it appears. Beyond the suspense, the film also explores a thought-provoking question: Have marriage and legal battles become a silent punishment for some innocent men, or is the truth far more complex than it seems? With every hearing, the truth becomes more elusive, and just when the verdict seems certain, an unexpected twist changes the entire direction of the case. A taut courtroom suspense thriller that keeps the audience guessing until the very last moment.

1647497.title: No Translation Required

On Day of the Dead, he tells his friend Memita how he met Gabby, an assistant at a Los Angeles fashion brand, after a chaotic night that ended with his taco stand blowing up. She invites him to try his luck in the United States, where Paco faces cultural barriers and romantic and work conflicts, until he is deported. Back in Mexico, he reflects on his future, until Gabby decides to leave her life in the US to start anew with him in Guadalajara.

1728713.title: No Eggs For Breakfast Today

1730697.title: Glimmer

Encouraged by his outspoken best friend and inspired by unexpected moments of connection, he discovers the power of ‘glimmers’—small, magical moments of hope that illuminate life’s path. Set against the vibrant backdrop of queer nightlife, fashion, and chosen family, Glimmer is a heartfelt story about resilience, self-worth, and believing in yourself when everything feels uncertain.

1732489.title: On the Fence
1732489.overview: Stretching more than 5,600 kilometres across the country, the Dingo Fence stands as a symbol of one of Australia’s longest-running and most complex debates. On one side, livelihoods depend on protecting livestock. On the other, a native apex predator plays a vital role in the health of our ecosystems. On The Fence is a feature documentary that brings together graziers, scientists, First Nations voices and conservationists to explore the people, landscapes and ideas at the heart of this conversation. Rather than asking who is right or wrong, On The Fence asks a different question: are we willing to coexist with apex predators and learn from the mistakes of our past?

1732809.title: OLD SOUL

1733257.title: Juan Gabriel: Mi Primer Bellas Artes
1733257.overview: Mexico’s most iconic concert comes to U.S. theaters on September 15th, celebrating Mexican Independence Day and commemorating the 10th anniversary of Juan Gabriel’s passing. Experience his legendary first performance at Mexico City’s “Palacio de Bellas Artes” in 1990—a landmark event that forever transformed Mexican music. More than three decades later, this historic concert returns in a special theatrical release with newly restored picture and sound, plus an exclusive new opening featuring never-before-seen rehearsal footage from Juan Gabriel’s personal archive that offers a unique glimpse into the making of this unforgettable night. Every song, every standing ovation, and every iconic moment has been revitalized, allowing longtime fans and new audiences to experience this extraordinary performance like never before. Celebrate the timeless legacy of Juan Gabriel on the big screen in this once-in-a-generation cinematic event.
1733257.original_title: Juan Gabriel: Mi Primer Bellas Artes

As dangerous weapons arrive at the base, they hold the monthly Paeng Paeng Cultural Festival, seeing Haje and the tree as a frontline of peace. 1769097.title: Accueil du grand âge, la méthode Montessori
1769097.overview: As Western populations grow older and cognitive disorders such as Alzheimer’s disease become increasingly prevalent, how can we rethink the way we care for and accommodate the elderly? More broadly, how should we approach our relationship with aging and old age?  The Montessori method, originally developed and recognized for fostering children’s development in educational settings, has proven particularly well suited to older adults. More than simply a practical tool, it represents a genuine shift in perspective on aging, one that is also revolutionizing approaches to care.

1769225.title: 77 Hours
1769225.overview: 77 Hours is a psychological thriller and political drama set across the nights of January 8 and 9, when Iran's streets become the scene of one of the darkest and bloodiest crackdowns in recent memory.  Unarmed and unprepared, ordinary people are trapped in chaos, gunfire, fear, and death. At the center is a man who is not a hero prepared for battle, but an ordinary person forced to survive in an inhuman catastrophe — surrounded by wounded civilians, security forces, and collapsing memories.  Through a tense, intimate narrative moving between streets, hospital corridors, hidden spaces, and broken recollections, the film explores survival, sacrifice, guilt, silence, and the fragile line between truth and fear.
